findings.title: Eligible Applicant Organizations
findings.fact: Qualifying organizations include nonprofit and faith-based organizations, government entities, public schools and universities, and Native American tribal councils.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must confirm it falls into one of these categories to be eligible to apply.

findings.title: Award Notification Timeline
findings.fact: Applicants will be notified of award approximately six weeks prior to the project start date.
findings.business_implication: The bidder should plan for a notification timeline that is close to the project start, which may affect planning.
findings.action_recommendation: Consider this timeline when planning project activities and resource allocation.

findings.title: Partner Responsibilities
findings.fact: Partner organizations must provide at least 40 hours per week of enriching service, daily technical supervision, all project materials, tools, protective gear, work permits, housing with full kitchen and bathroom, and service-learning education.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must be prepared to meet substantial logistical and supervisory obligations.
findings.action_recommendation: Assess capacity to provide housing, supervision, and materials as required.

quotes.quote: • At least 40 hours per week of enriching service that meets the needs named in your application • A broad range of different types of service experiences for the team • Daily technical supervision for the team, including on-the-job training • Orientation to the organization and community • All project materials, tools, and protective gear • Any work permits required to complete service • Service-learning education on community needs and deeper issues related to the project • Housing for the team, to include a full kitchen, full bathroom with showers, cleaning supplies, and toilet paper for the duration of the project
